name: traj
meaning: the trajectory it follows ({u16 count; Vec3s pts[count]}): TrajFollower_Init 0x510731 stores it, TrajFollower_Step 0x51079b reads count and pts; BipbipLevel14's own follower reads it the same way (0x42e91d-0x42eb65)

name: pointIndex
meaning: index of the waypoint currently being steered toward; wraps to 0 at the end

name: speed
meaning: movement speed in units/s; multiplies the normalised direction to give the output velocity

name: headingBias
meaning: constant added to the atan2 heading; every call site passes 0x800 (half a turn)

name: heading
meaning: cached 12-bit facing toward the current waypoint; reused unchanged when neither advanced nor continuousHeading is set

name: arriveRadiusSq
meaning: squared arrival radius; the waypoint is consumed while the squared distance is below it

name: continuousHeading
meaning: when non-zero the heading is recomputed every step; when zero it is only refreshed on waypoint change

name: use3dDistance
meaning: when non-zero the vertical delta is included in the arrival distance and in the output velocity

name: moving
meaning: set to 1 by every step, cleared by init; a 'follower is running' latch

name: advanced
meaning: 1 when at least one waypoint was consumed during this step (used to trigger the heading recompute)
